seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid (36 cells) of small circles, all the same size. 35 of the circles are bright red. One circle, located at row 4 column 5, is a slightly darker shade of red — close enough to look red at a glance.
seeds.question: Which cell contains the odd-one-out, and how does it differ?
seeds.answer: Row 4, column 5 — a slightly darker shade of red than the rest
seeds.lever: Subtle color-shade difference among many; tests fine color discrimination at scale.

seeds.scene: A scattered cluster of about 50 black dots on a white background. All dots appear to be the same size (3 mm diameter). One dot, near the lower-left of the cluster, is 4 mm diameter (about 30% larger).
seeds.question: Identify and locate the odd-one-out dot.
seeds.answer: The dot in the lower-left of the cluster, which is approximately 30% larger in diameter than the others
seeds.lever: Subtle size difference; one dot among many similar-looking dots.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of upward-pointing arrows (25 total). 24 arrows point straight up; 1 arrow at row 2 column 4 is rotated by 5° clockwise (still close to vertical but slightly tilted to the right).
seeds.question: Which arrow is rotated differently?
seeds.answer: The arrow at row 2, column 4 — tilted ~5° clockwise from vertical
seeds.lever: Small rotation among uniform orientation.

seeds.scene: A 7×7 grid of the lowercase letter 'o' rendered in a serif font. 48 cells contain the letter 'o'. One cell at row 3 column 6 contains the digit '0' (zero) in the same font; in this serif font the 0 is slightly taller and narrower than the o.
seeds.question: Which cell does NOT contain the letter 'o'?
seeds.answer: Row 3, column 6 — contains the digit 0 (zero) instead of the letter o
seeds.lever: Glyph-substitution outlier requiring fine character distinction.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of identical yellow smiley faces (36 total). 35 faces have two black eyes and a curved smile. One face at row 5 column 2 has only one eye drawn (the right eye is missing).
seeds.question: Which face is the odd one?
seeds.answer: Row 5, column 2 — missing the right eye
seeds.lever: Missing micro-feature in a busy field of similar icons.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of identical stick-figure people with both arms raised at ~45° above horizontal (25 figures). 24 figures have arms exactly symmetrical. One figure at row 3 column 3 has the left arm at 45° but the right arm at 30° (a subtle asymmetry).
seeds.question: Identify the asymmetric figure.
seeds.answer: Row 3, column 3 — right arm at a slightly lower angle than the left
seeds.lever: Pose asymmetry among uniform stick figures.

seeds.scene: A 8×8 grid where colors alternate in a checkerboard pattern of red and white squares. 63 cells follow the pattern. The cell at row 5 column 4 (which 'should' be red per the checkerboard) is white instead, breaking the pattern.
seeds.question: Where is the pattern broken?
seeds.answer: Row 5, column 4 — should be red per the checkerboard but is white
seeds.lever: Pattern-violation localization in a regular grid.

seeds.scene: A page showing 30 small clusters of black dots, each cluster surrounded by a thin circle. 29 of the clusters contain exactly 7 dots. One cluster (in the lower-right area) contains 6 dots.
seeds.question: Which cluster has a different dot count?
seeds.answer: The cluster in the lower-right area — contains 6 dots while all others contain 7
seeds.lever: Counting consistency across many small groups.

seeds.scene: A radial arrangement of 24 arrows around a center point, all pointing inward toward the center (like spokes pointing to the hub). 23 arrows point inward; one arrow at the 7-o'clock position points outward (away from the center).
seeds.question: Which arrow is reversed?
seeds.answer: The arrow at the 7-o'clock position — points outward instead of inward
seeds.lever: Reversed direction in a radially symmetric arrangement.

seeds.scene: A page densely filled with the word 'banana' repeated 50 times in a 5×10 grid, all in the same font. 49 instances are spelled 'banana'. One instance in row 3 column 7 is spelled 'banama' (third 'n' replaced with 'm').
seeds.question: Identify the misspelled word and its location.
seeds.answer: Row 3, column 7 — spelled 'banama' instead of 'banana'
seeds.lever: Single-character text typo in a sea of identical words.

seeds.scene: A repeating polka-dot pattern of small blue dots on a white background, roughly 100 dots arranged in 10 rows of 10. All dots appear blue. One dot near the center is purple (a slightly redder shade than the surrounding blue).
seeds.question: Find the odd-colored dot.
seeds.answer: The single purple dot near the center of the pattern
seeds.lever: Subtle hue shift in a busy pattern.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of the letter 'A' (25 total) all in Times New Roman serif font. One cell at row 2 column 3 contains the letter 'A' in Arial sans-serif font (no serifs at the feet).
seeds.question: Which cell has the differently-styled A?
seeds.answer: Row 2, column 3 — sans-serif Arial A vs serif Times A elsewhere
seeds.lever: Typography difference at small scale.

seeds.scene: A 4×6 grid of identical 5-petal flower icons (24 total). 23 flowers have exactly 5 petals. One flower at row 3 column 5 has 6 petals.
seeds.question: Which flower has a different petal count?
seeds.answer: Row 3, column 5 — has 6 petals instead of 5
seeds.lever: Counting petals on small icons; extra-element outlier.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of the uppercase letter 'P' (36 total). 35 P's are upright and face the right side. One P at row 5 column 5 is mirrored — its bowl faces left (i.e., it looks like a backwards P).
seeds.question: Which letter is mirrored?
seeds.answer: Row 5, column 5 — mirror-flipped P (bowl on left)
seeds.lever: Mirror-flip outlier among uniform glyphs.

seeds.scene: A 7×7 grid of small circles (49 total). 48 circles are outlined only (white interior, black border). One circle at row 6 column 4 is fully filled in black.
seeds.question: Which circle is differently rendered?
seeds.answer: Row 6, column 4 — fully filled black circle vs outlined elsewhere
seeds.lever: Fill-style outlier; visually loud but in a busy field.

seeds.scene: A pattern of 30 horizontal parallel lines on a page. 29 lines are 1-pixel thick. One line, the 17th from the top, is 2-pixel thick.
seeds.question: Which line is thicker than the others?
seeds.answer: The 17th line from the top
seeds.lever: Subtle thickness difference in a line array.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of identical 'smiling face' emojis (25 total). 24 are smiling. One emoji at row 4 column 2 is a 'neutral face' (straight-line mouth instead of smile).
seeds.question: Find the odd emoji.
seeds.answer: Row 4, column 2 — neutral face instead of smiling
seeds.lever: Expression difference at small scale.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of identical chess-knight icons (36 total). All 36 knights face left. One knight at row 3 column 4 is identical except it is shifted ~5 pixels to the right within its grid cell, breaking the alignment.
seeds.question: Which cell has a positionally misaligned knight?
seeds.answer: Row 3, column 4 — shifted slightly right within its cell
seeds.lever: Positional alignment outlier rather than appearance outlier.

seeds.scene: A 6×7 grid of identical hexagons (42 total). 41 are regular hexagons. One at row 4 column 6 is a heptagon (7 sides) drawn at the same overall size.
seeds.question: Which cell has a non-hexagonal shape?
seeds.answer: Row 4, column 6 — heptagon (7 sides) instead of hexagon (6 sides)
seeds.lever: Side-count difference in similar-looking polygons.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of small black-cat silhouettes (25 total). 24 cats are entirely black. One at row 1 column 5 is dark gray (just a few shades lighter than black, close enough to be missed at first glance).
seeds.question: Which cat is the odd one?
seeds.answer: Row 1, column 5 — dark gray cat among black cats
seeds.lever: Subtle brightness difference in a uniform field.

seeds.scene: A 4×6 grid of identical raised-hand icons (24 total). 23 hands show 5 fingers (4 fingers + thumb). One hand at row 2 column 3 shows 6 fingers (extra index finger).
seeds.question: Which hand has a different finger count?
seeds.answer: Row 2, column 3 — has 6 fingers instead of 5
seeds.lever: Counting fingers on small icons; extra-element outlier.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of identical sun icons (25 total) — each sun has a central circle and 8 ray spikes. 24 suns have all 8 rays. One sun at row 4 column 1 is missing one ray (the bottom-left ray).
seeds.question: Which sun is missing a ray?
seeds.answer: Row 4, column 1 — missing the bottom-left ray (only 7 rays)
seeds.lever: Missing micro-feature requiring careful count.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of identical small pie-chart icons (36 total), each split into two halves: top half blue, bottom half green. 35 icons follow this pattern. One icon at row 3 column 5 has the colors swapped (top green, bottom blue).
seeds.question: Which icon has its colors swapped?
seeds.answer: Row 3, column 5 — top green/bottom blue (swapped vs the rest)
seeds.lever: Color-swap outlier within composite icons.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of identical butterfly icons (25 total). 24 butterflies are perfectly bilateral-symmetric (left wing matches right wing). One butterfly at row 2 column 2 has its left wing slightly larger than its right.
seeds.question: Which butterfly is asymmetric?
seeds.answer: Row 2, column 2 — left wing is slightly larger than right
seeds.lever: Bilateral asymmetry in icons that should be symmetric.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of the letter 'X' (36 total). 35 X's are in regular weight. One X at row 1 column 4 is in bold weight (visibly thicker strokes).
seeds.question: Which X is bold?
seeds.answer: Row 1, column 4 — bold X among regular-weight X's
seeds.lever: Font-weight difference; subtle stroke thickness change.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 grid of numbers (25 cells), each cell showing '3.14'. 24 cells show '3.14'. One cell at row 4 column 4 shows '3.41' (the digits after the decimal are transposed).
seeds.question: Which cell has the wrong number?
seeds.answer: Row 4, column 4 — shows 3.41 instead of 3.14
seeds.lever: Digit-transposition in a uniform numeric field.

seeds.scene: A 7×7 grid of small black dots, each centered in its cell. 48 dots are perfectly centered. One dot at row 6 column 3 is shifted ~3 pixels down from center.
seeds.question: Which dot is off-center?
seeds.answer: Row 6, column 3 — dot shifted slightly downward from cell center
seeds.lever: Sub-pixel-scale position outlier.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of the letter 'i' in lowercase (36 total). 35 i's have a single dot above. One i at row 5 column 6 has two dots (like an umlaut ï).
seeds.question: Which letter has extra decoration?
seeds.answer: Row 5, column 6 — has two dots above (ï) instead of one (i)
seeds.lever: Diacritic difference; subtle micro-element.

seeds.scene: An illustration of a school of about 40 small fish all swimming to the right (heads pointing right). One fish near the back of the school is swimming to the left (head pointing left).
seeds.question: Which fish is swimming the wrong direction?
seeds.answer: The single fish near the back of the school facing left while all others face right
seeds.lever: Direction-of-motion outlier in a coherent group.

seeds.scene: A 8×8 grid of 64 small squares. The grid alternates rows of red and blue squares (32 red, 32 blue). Within the red rows, all squares are red EXCEPT one at row 1 column 6, which is a slightly orangish-red. Within the blue rows, all squares are uniform blue.
seeds.question: In which row–column is the odd-colored square, and what color is it?
seeds.answer: Row 1, column 6 — slightly orangish-red instead of pure red
seeds.lever: Outlier in a multi-color pattern; distractor of two colors makes the search harder.
